thread:
Maya P.: quick preflight — can we confirm the v0.23.1 version bump is in the release branch? I pushed a tag candidate but want owners to ack before canary.
Aj Patel: I created the branch and pushed the candidate tag locally, pushing now. cc @Sophie L for changelog note.
Sophie L: will add a one-line entry to CHANGELOG.md (fix: small-batch runtime crash) and push in a minute.
Aj Patel: pushed tag v0.23.1 -> sha abc1234. release-bot, please run CI.
release-bot: CI queued for release/v0.23.x @sha: abc1234. Status will update here. :robot_face:
Hector G: ran quick security grep on the diff, nothing suspicious. flagged two deps but both are patch bumps.
Maya P.: thanks Hector — can you ack security sign-off? we need it for the checklist.
Hector G: acked.
Sophie L: changelog commit pushed: 9f8e7a — short entry and link to PR #425.
Maya P.: OK — QA, can you run the smoke and perf quick checks on canary once it's up? @Devon (QA) @qa-automation
Devon (QA): starting smoke suite now, ETA ~12m. I'll report back with failures.
qa-automation: automated suites started: smoke, e2e-lite, perf-smoke. Currently 0/3 done.
Devon (QA): smoke returned 2 failures (flaky HTTP timeout on embeddings endpoint, and a transient race in session expiry). Re-running the flaky test now.
Devon (QA): re-run passed. embedding timeout seems tied to a bad node in staging, not the code. marking as flaky.
Maya P.: good — we're OK to canary once CI is green and QA gives thumbs. owners for the deploy: @Aj Patel (merge + rollout), @Hector G (security pager), @Maya P. (release lead).
Aj Patel: preparing canary command: `./deploy --env canary --ref v0.23.1 --group release` — will run at 15:30 UTC unless any objections.
Sophie L: no objections. docs link included in release notes.
Maya P.: small reminder for cutover: update the version in docs site and pin the metrics dashboard to v0.23.1 so we can correlate regressions.
Sophie L: done docs update. docs commit 2b4d1c.
Hector G: security checklist items checked: dependency CVEs reviewed, runtime flags verified, audit log toggles enabled. all green.
release-bot: CI passed for sha abc1234 — all checks green.
Devon (QA): full suite: 312/316 passing, 3 known flaky tests rerun/ignored, 1 new failure (indexing.timeout) — investigating now.
Devon (QA): indexing timeout traced to a misconfigured staging indexer. not related to release. marking as non-blocking.
Maya P.: final ask: owners please add short sign-off in this thread once you confirm you can be on-call for the canary window (15:30–16:30 UTC).
Aj Patel: on call for the window. :white_check_mark:
Hector G: on security pager for the window. :white_check_mark:
Devon (QA): QA available for post-rollout checks. :white_check_mark:
Maya P.: thanks all — proceeding with canary at 15:30 UTC. I'll post cutover notes and the rollback command here.
Maya P.: rollback snippet if needed:
```
# rollback to previous stable
./deploy --env canary --action rollback --ref v0.23.0
```
Maya P.: leaving final checklist items: changelog? done. docs? done. security? done. QA smoke? done/ack. tag pushed? done. CI? green. proceeding. :shipit:
